name: com.noncasted.framework.telemetry
description: Client telemetry: numbers and names from the code are collected once a second inside a session the game opens, and go through ITelemetryTransport: JSON over HTTP with AddHttpClientTelemetry, or over the meta socket with AddSocketClientTelemetry (assembly Internal.Telemetry.Socket, compiled only with the network package); the base metrics come with AddStandardTelemetryCollectors, the other collectors belong to the game (namespace Global.Telemetry).
